title: Refined Wireless Upgrades
description: Expands your Refined Storage Wireless Grid with automatic inventory transfers, block picking, item collection, and additional energy capacity upgrades
body:
If you want to put this mod in your modpack, feel free to use it :)
_Formerly known as RS Insert Export Upgrade._
## Insert Upgrade The Insert Upgrade takes items in specific slots of your inventory and dumps them into your network.
Open up your wireless grid and add the insert or export or block picker upgrade in the slot on the right.

To configure it, click on one of the new left side buttons.

Clicking on slots makes a checkmark. Any item in the slot that has a checkmark will get imported to your network. You can whitelist or blacklist items by adding them to the filter at the top.
## Export Upgrade
The Export Upgrade works exactly the same but will pull items from your Refined Storage into your inventory. To specify what items, drag the item from JEI into one of the slots at the top and click on a slot in your inventory to change it to the desired number. Right clicking clears back to X.
## Block Picker Upgrade Lets you extract the block you are currently looking at directly from your Network. Simply aim at a block and press the "Pick Block" keybind. If the matching block is available in your network, it will be extracted into your inventory.
## Magnet Upgrade Automatically collects nearby dropped items into your inventory or directly into your storage network. - Pickup Filter: Choose which items the magnet collects. - Pickup Destination: Send collected items to your inventory or network. - Insert Filter: In Network mode, choose which collected items enter the network. Other items and anything the network cannot accept go to your inventory. Items that cannot fit remain on the ground. ## Energy Capacity Upgrade Increase your Wireless Grid's energy capacity by 1,000 FE per upgrade by default. Install up to two Energy Capacity Upgrades per grid. [![](https://i.imgur.com/0KFppoR.png)](https://www.akliz.net/ultra) [Need a server?
